sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to services reported using the 1500 Health Insurance Claim Form (a/k/a CMS-1500) or its electronic equivalent or its successor form. This policy applies to all products and all network and non-network physicians and other qualified health care professionals, including, but not limited to, non-network authorized and percent of charge contract physicians and other qualified health care professionals.

children.title: United Healthcare Commercial
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all UnitedHealthcare Commercial benefit plans.

children.title: UnitedHealthcare Individual Exchange
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all Individual Exchange benefit plans.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Care Plan Oversight (CPO) Services refer to physician and other qualified health care professional supervision of patients under the care of home health agencies, hospice, or nursing facilities. Care Plan Oversight services are reported separately from codes for office/outpatient, hospital, home, nursing facility, or domiciliary services. Code selection for Care Plan Oversight Services is determined by the complexity and approximate time spent by the physician or other qualified health care professional within a 30-day period.

value.Q: Does UnitedHealthcare reimburse Care Plan Oversight Services codes for less than 30 minutes?
value.A: UnitedHealthcare follows CMS payment methodology for reimbursement of Care Plan Oversight Services. According to the CMS Medicare Benefit Policy Manual, Covered Medical and Other Health Services, Chapter 15, Section 30, these services are covered only if the physician furnished at least 30 minutes of Care Plan Oversight within the calendar month for which payment is claimed.
